Needs changes before merge.

The count helper gives the correct singular and plural forms. The status strip still hides the count for zero operations. The new structural test checks both forms through the shell harness and an operation command. I found no code defect in this change.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `7f2d9bfc4efe40dbf12e06c93f2675896814925b`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui` | 1204 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored |
| New status count test | Passed in the library suite |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 7 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `tap_hand` | 3 passed |
| `theme_example` | 3 passed |
| `theme_files` | 17 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

I stopped the first gate planner build after it made no progress with sccache. The planner and all checks completed with the wrapper disabled. The planner included changes from upstream in the pending merge. I selected the UI suites from this PR's diff instead. No GitHub runner ran.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1628`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for this visible UI change. Show the status strip with one operation before and after the fix. Store the images only on your fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not add them to this PR branch or change the snapshot PNGs. The current body has no screenshots and says no visual check ran.

Notes:

- This change does not affect posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. No safety mutations were required. No golden files changed.
- The existing `structural.rs` file exceeds 400 lines. This PR adds three lines to register a separate test module. This is not a blocker.
- I checked the laws from the current upstream/main `AGENTS.md`. The new module has a provenance comment. No dependency or process file changed.
- I did not launch the GUI or run the ignored pixel snapshot tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
